result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and a bottom card is cut off by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width so full restaurant names are visible.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant/promo card (pizza image) is partially cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding part of the content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards clear the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category chip row is clipped on the right (partial chip visible after 'Healthy'), with no clear affordance that more options exist.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek of the next chip, a chevron, or ensure proper horizontal scroll padding so overflow is intentional and discoverable.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the truncated card ('€1.90 delivery') is fine, but the incomplete name harms scannability of the list.
issues.suggestion: Pair truncation fix with consistent card width and optional ellipsis only when necessary after layout adjustments.
